answer: Identity activation costs a verifiable compute puzzle seeded by the epoch, roughly one minute per key, and the solution is checked before any answer is accepted. Spinning up 620 aliases means 620 minutes of real compute each epoch, which prices a farm out of profit while a single honest agent barely notices. The saffron test is the live device, the wander test is the locked stake, and the glacier test is the graded history no template can fake.
